# Inline

> Inline is a work chat app for teams and agents. Use these docs for app setup, developer APIs, the hosted MCP server, CLI, and integrations.

## Docs

- [Welcome](https://inline.chat/docs/index.md): Start here for Inline docs and product status.
- [What's Inline](https://inline.chat/docs/whats-inline.md): Product goals and design principles.
- [Downloads](https://inline.chat/docs/downloads.md): Current app download links.
- [Roadmap](https://inline.chat/docs/roadmap.md): Current product roadmap status.
- [CLI](https://inline.chat/docs/cli.md): Install and authenticate the Inline command line tool.
- [Developers](https://inline.chat/docs/developers.md): Overview of Inline developer surfaces.
- [Realtime API](https://inline.chat/docs/realtime-api.md): WebSocket API and TypeScript SDK quick start.
- [Bot API](https://inline.chat/docs/bot-api.md): HTTP API for bot integrations and automations.
- [Creating a Bot](https://inline.chat/docs/creating-a-bot.md): Create or reveal an Inline bot token.
- [MCP](https://inline.chat/docs/mcp.md): Connect MCP-compatible agents to Inline with OAuth consent.
- [OpenClaw](https://inline.chat/docs/openclaw.md): Configure the official Inline OpenClaw plugin.
- [Hermes Agent](https://inline.chat/docs/hermes.md): Run Hermes Agent from Inline chats.
- [Security](https://inline.chat/docs/security.md): Security posture, encryption, and vulnerability reporting.

## Machine-readable References

- [Full docs corpus](https://inline.chat/llms-full.txt): All public docs concatenated as Markdown.
- [OpenAPI spec](https://inline.chat/openapi.json): Bot HTTP API schema.
- [Integration declaration](https://inline.chat/.well-known/integrations.json): Machine-readable integration metadata.
- [MCP server card](https://inline.chat/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Hosted MCP endpoint and OAuth metadata.
